async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the filter row for the Telephone column and fill in the phone number
    # The filter row is the second row in the rowgroup of the third table (customer data table).
    # Use the accessibility tree: the third table has a rowgroup with a filter row after the header row.
    # The Telephone column is the 5th cell in the filter row (0-indexed index 4).
    filter_row = page.get_by_role("table").nth(2).get_by_role("rowgroup").get_by_role("row").nth(1)  # Second row is the filter row
    telephone_cell = filter_row.get_by_role("cell").nth(4)  # 5th cell for Telephone
    textbox = telephone_cell.get_by_role("textbox")
    await textbox.fill("+1 2058812302")
    # Click the Search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Additional wait for any dynamic updates
    # Check if any customer row with the phone number appears
    # Look for rows in the customer data table (third table in the page)
    customer_table = page.get_by_role("table").nth(2)  # Third table contains customer data
    rows = customer_table.get_by_role("rowgroup").get_by_role("row").all()
    # Skip the header row (first row) and filter row (second row), but after search, only matching rows should show.
    for row in rows:
        # Check if this row has a cell with the phone number
        cells = row.get_by_role("cell").all()
        if len(cells) >= 5:  # At least 5 cells to include Telephone column
            telephone_cell_text = await cells[4].inner_text()  # Telephone is 5th cell (0-indexed 4)
            if "+1 2058812302" in telephone_cell_text:
                # Extract name and email from this row
                name_cell_text = await cells[2].inner_text()  # Name is 3rd cell (0-indexed 2)
                email_cell_text = await cells[3].inner_text()  # Email is 4th cell (0-indexed 3)
                result = f"Name: {name_cell_text}, Email: {email_cell_text}"
                print(result)
                return
    # If no match found
    print("No customer found with phone number +1 2058812302.")
